_comment: E5 (2026-08-13): the CANONICAL current-verdict summary, one entry per
strategy, maintained alongside the append-only gate log. This file
exists because dashboard._evidence_section used to parse the log's
markdown tables last-row-wins and hardcode a 48-trial-era paragraph —
it served meanrev's REVERTED §5 PASS on the public page for weeks
while config.yaml said the strategy was killed. The dashboard now
renders THIS file, and tests/test_gate_verdicts.py pins it against
config.yaml (enabled flags), the gate log's own final tally line, and
the cited sections' existence — so drift fails the build instead of
lying on the page. Update it in the same commit as any new verdict.
